nom: Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Detoxifying Face Cleanser

avis.texte: I was unsure about this one but it works great. Brings your blackheads to the surface to scrub off for sure!

avis.titre: Combo skin: this one is for you
avis.texte: I was gifted the Clear Improvement Zero Oil Charcoal Detoxifying Face Cleanser by Origins and overall, I'm pretty happy with it! The texture is smooth with a gentle lather, and it has a refreshing, clean scent—nothing too overpowering. I really like the cooling sensation it gives during and after washing. It feels like it's doing something right away, and it definitely leaves my skin feeling clean and less oily without over-drying. However, I wouldn't call it a miracle product. It didn't completely prevent breakouts, especially around hormonal periods, but it did help reduce their severity. Also, if you have very dry or sensitive skin, this might be a little too intense for daily use.

The Origins Zero Oil Active Charcoal Cleanser leaves my skin feeling super clean and refreshed without over-drying. The charcoal really helps detox my pores and control excess oil, making it perfect for breakout-prone or oily skin days. It's a go-to in my routine when my skin needs a deep cleanse!

I have huge pores around my t-zone and I've been using this cleanser for almost 2 weeks now and it's crazy how I can already tell the difference! I would 100% recommend this product if you have the same issue! gifted by origins

I was super excited to receive the origins zero oil, active detoxifying, charcoal activated cleanser for my face. I love something that is going to help with my oiliness throughout the day, and I love a cleanser with this type of consistency.

This cleanser that I received complimentary from origins has worked so well for me. I like that it doesn't have a strong odor and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. It leaves my skin feeling so refreshed and clean.

Gifted by Origins. Facial cleansing gel with activated carbon. This is extremely good for blackheads, dilated dicks and oily skin. This cleans your skin in depth, what's more, I could tell you that you can even use it as an exfoliant once or twice a week because if you use it every day. You could dry out your skin. It's very good but use it sparingly.

Gifted by Origins in exchange for an honest review. I am loving this cleanser for summer — it leaves my skin feeling soft and my pores sooo clear. The texture of my skin has improved after using this cleanser daily morning and evening.

Great cleanser for everyday! It has a refreshing scent and feels nice when cleansing. I found that my skin didn't feel stripped or tight afterwards. I double-cleanse with a cleansing oil or wipe beforehand so I can't comment on its ability to remove makeup, but it's great as a second cleanser.

this face wash has made my skin feel so clean and doesn't dry it out in the process. it helps get rid of all the dirt and makeup on my face that has built up throughout the day and i'm obsessed! Complimentary from origins

Complimentary from origins. I have heard amazing things about this brand so getting the chance to try this out is super awesome! It doesn't affect my skin in a negative way or make me break out which is great.

I love my new face cleanser! It's not oily or heavy on my skin, which is exactly what I was looking for. This brand has so many great products that I keep buying them all the time, and I think this one will become one of my favorites too!

This is amazing! I was gifted this product and I absolutely love it. I had been looking for a new cleanser and it really works so well. My skin is smooth now and it really helps with any acne or skin issues

Complimentary from origins. Whenever I get a facial, I'm always told my pores are extremely congested and blocked, even without visible acne. I keep being told to try different things to unblock the pores. I sweat and workout a lot so it's a challenge. This is making a difference. I'm shocked.

I was Gifted by origins Clear Improvement with active charcoal to detox the skin and I have been loving it!! I love how this cleans my skin so well and it smells clean and fresh! I also love how this product doesn't leave an oily feeling when washing the face and I have noticed my skin improving from one week of use!

The Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Face Mask is a go-to when my skin feels congested or overly greasy. It helps clear out my pores, soak up excess oil, and leaves my skin feeling refreshed and smoother. I use it once or twice a week and always notice my skin looks clearer and more balanced after. Great for my combo/oily skin, but gentle enough not to dry me out.

I was so excited to be gifted by Origins this cleanser. If you struggle with acne prone oily skin look not further. This has been leaving my skin feeling so clean and refreshed even in the hot summer heat when I have sunscreen and makeup on. Highly recommend.

I was gifted and I've been testing out this gel-to-foam cleanser and let me just say—my pores are thanking me! 🙌🏼 Infused with Salicylic Acid and Active Charcoal, this cleanser does exactly what it promises: clears out pore-clogging oil, makeup, and pollution without leaving your skin feeling tight or dry. What I love most is how fresh and clean my skin feels after using it—hello minty refresh! 🌿 It's non-stripping and gentle enough for daily use, which is a must for me. After just one week, I've noticed my pores look more refined and my complexion looks less congested. 👏🏼

I use this once a week and it's so amazing! I love that it really clears up my skin and it is amazing for all skin types, my skin is less red and so much clearer. I recommend this to everyone! Gifted by origins

This cleanser does exactly what it claims deeply cleanses, removes oil, and leaves skin feeling fresh. My face feels clean without being stripped. Love the charcoal! I received this product for free but would buy with my own money

avis.titre: Love the clean feeling on my skin
avis.texte: With its easy to use packaging, makes washing my face a lot easy. The texture of the cleanser is nice. Not too runny but good consistency. Having oily skin it did not make my face feel dry or patchy after washing and pat drying. I highly recommend it for oily skin more than dry skin folks.

I was gifted by origins. The Origins Active Charcoal Detoxifying Cleanser is a true skin savior for anyone dealing with congested pores, excess oil, or dull skin. From the very first use, you can feel this cleanser going to work—drawing out impurities, deeply cleansing without over-stripping, and leaving your skin feeling refreshed and balanced. Formulated with activated bamboo charcoal, it acts like a magnet for dirt and debris, helping to decongest pores and prevent breakouts. The texture is smooth and creamy with a gentle lather that rinses off easily, making it feel more like a spa experience than a daily routine. There's also a subtle, clean scent that adds to the soothing vibe without being overpowering. What I love most is that it leaves your skin feeling truly clean—never tight or dry. It's ideal for oily or combination skin types, but gentle enough to use a few times a week even if you're more on the sensitive side. Over time, I've noticed a real difference in my skin's clarity, fewer blackheads, and a more even texture. If you're looking for a dependable, detoxifying cleanser that delivers real results without harsh ingredients, Origins' Active Charcoal Cleanser is worth every drop.

After using this cleanser, i find that it helps remove all of my makeup and even acts as a gentle scrub and i love that! I also like that my pores have been less noticeable. I really recommend this product. This was Complimentary from origins.

This Clear Improvement face cleanser is a perfect one for those who are experiencing teenage or adult acne. It reduces appearance of the pores and keeps your skin sebum free. It smells minty which is kinda refreshing in the morning.

Awesome face wash. Cleanses the skin really well. I have combination skin, so I'm careful when choosing products—I want something that deeply cleans pores but doesn't leave my skin feeling tight. This one is absolutely perfect. Plus, it lathers nicely. And what I really like is that it's completely fragrance-free. Complimentary from origins

I've really been enjoying this face cleanser. I typically don't change up my cleansers very often but this one has kept my skin clear and feels great. My boyfriend also uses it! I use it every night in the shower. Gifted by Origins

This works really good love that it doesn't take much to really get my skin super clean and it makes my skin less textured after I have washed with this and followed go with origins moisturizer. This also only takes a little.

This face wash works incredible love that it only takes a little tiny bit and it lathers up super good this also only takes me one wash and not a double cleanse which I love and this does get my makeup off.

Complimentary from origins This cleanser leaves my skin feeling deeply cleansed but not stripped. The charcoal gives it a nice detox effect, and it really helps control excess oil in my T-zone. It lathers well, rinses off easily, and feels refreshing after each use. Great for combo or oily skin types, I can see this becoming a staple in my routine.

I have combination skin, so I like that this doesn't have oil(I don't need help in that department lol, especially in the summer). This doesn't the job but isn't drying and doesn't strip but my face feels refreshed after I use it. Love Origins products.

avis.titre: You might as well rinse your face with Water
avis.texte: The worst cleanser money can buy. Rinsing your face with water will probably be more efficient than this cleanser cuz it literally does nothing. My face got acne and more clogged pores and blackheads because this doesn't clean anything out

I was really scared reading the reviews for this product update. I've been using this face wash for a long time and it works great. When someone said it wasn't the same I panicked. I went to my local shop to get a sample and it was totally different. I said, there's no way it changed that much. They must have given me a sample of the wrong product. I took a chance when it was on sale for Christmas and bought. Thank goodness I did, because it the same great product!
a great product that really helps with minimizing acne. it is somewhat drying, but just be sure to moisturize your skin afterwards.

Like many of the other reviewers, I too used the previous Zero Oil cleanser. Unlike some of them, I enjoy the new formula with more salicylic acid and the addition of charcoal. It rinses clean, keeps my skin clear (with a facial brush) and frankly smells great (like a minty herbaceous scent). I appreciate Origins' ability to make a gel cleanser where a little bit goes a long way; a small amount gives good lather. I think a lot of the other reviewers are being a bit dramatic and are just upset about the natural turnover of a product's life cycle. This is a solid cleansing choice for those with oilier skin types.

avis.titre: Not as good as it was before it went charcoal
avis.texte: I used to really love this product. It has gotten muddy and less clean feeling.

avis.titre: Another product ruined by an overzealous marketing team
avis.texte: You took a beloved, proven formula and redesigned it for the worse, hoping to capitalize on a burgeoning charcoal trend. You took a clear, translucent, and compact package and made it uglier, taller, and opaque. This is Tropicana-level marketing failure.

I do not want charcoal in my facewash, pls bring back the original product! The old formula was perfect and did not need to be changed. I have been using the original Zero Oil facewash since 2008 and am disappointed that it's not available now. Thank you

avis.titre: Long time customer but no more
avis.texte: I loved this product when it was the Zero Oil with Saw Palmetto. I have used it for years. It was the only thing that kept my face clear & not oily all day. Now that its been changed my face is breaking out very badly & gets oily again after 2-3 hours. Very disappointed. Please bring back the original.

This is mine and my partner's holy grail face wash for many years now. Even with the new formula, we haven't found a better salicylic acid face wash that works for our oily skin and acne. We feel so refreshed and clean without feeling dry or stripped. We would probably be devastated if this product is discontinued since it seems to not work for many others.
Both my daughter and I have tried this product and it leaves your face feeling great!

avis.titre: Bring the the ZERO OIL DEEP PORE CLEANSER BACK!
avis.texte: I have been a loyal customer for 23 years. The staple items I would buy over and over are gone. The Zero Oil Deep Pore Cleanser with saw palmetto and mint was THE BEST! Please bring it back. I miss the Smoothing Souffle as well. I have not purchased anything from Origins in a long time, because there are so many other lines of skin care available to try. I would buy the Zero Oil Deep Pore Cleanser in a heartbeat over other products if it was available.

I personally had never used the apparent original formula people are so upset over in the reviews so this is solely based on the current product as listed. I love it. I was typically usung a drug store anti acne wash that was doing just fine but i wanted something nicer. Got it home and thought it was a little simple, reminded me of the Biore charcoal cleanser which was intense. This has a similar scent and feel but it is WAY more gentle on my skin. Took a week or so go get used to it, but now it is the only cleanser i use. My skin is clear and even, i hardly get any blemishes, and i am significantly less oily. Love it.

Why change something that CLEARLY everyone was happy with? This new cleanser is awful. My face broke out so bad with this new "formula." I'm currently looking for a new cleanser. Origins lost my business on this cleanser.
The only face wash that gets all of my makeup off including my waterproof eye makeup.

I switched from another cleanser to this one and instantly saw a change in how clean my face felt. I always follow it up with a moisturizer, and it makes all the difference in how clean and smooth my face feels!

I've used this cleanser for a few years now with occasional switching from other lines from origins. Verdict is good. It can be a little bit drying but follow with the charcoal moisturizer and that helps.

I love this! Left my face feeling very smooth. If I liked it this much, I wonder how good the old product must've been for all the comments to support that. Hopefully I didn't just get a sample of the original because I absolutely loved it and want to order more

avis.titre: Not as good as old product
avis.texte: I've been buying the Zero Oil since my early college days. The smell was 5 stars and it was amazing for my skin. I was so disappointed to learn that they are no longer selling the old version and have this one with charcoal now. Seems like they're adding so much charcoal to things. I've tried my best to give this product a chance because I love Origins but it does not compare to the earliest version! Disappointed. Please listen to your customers and feedback and bring it back.
This new product is not as good as the old. I didn't noticed they chanced the product when I ordered. I wish I still had a stockpile of the old product.

avis.titre: Poor replacement for a previously fantastic product
avis.texte: This new product is a poor substitute for the original Zero Oil Deep Pore Cleanser with Saw Palmetto and Mint. I used that original for years and it was perfect! My skin went from oily to clear and baby-soft smooth instantly, and lasted all day. This new formula with Active Charcoal Detoxifying feels like it does nothing to clean, and just feels oily again before long. Really a shame to now have to search for a perfect cleanser all over again. Maybe I can find some old stock somewhere.

The Zero OIl they used to have was THE best cleanser ever. I used this just because I still liked their products, but I do not order anymore. It doesn't foam or clean like the other blend. You feel oily again within a few minutes. If they would bring back the other stuff I would order from them again, but for now I have stopped. Sorry Origins, I like your products but that was the main reason I kept ordering.

This is not an improvement on the original Zero Oil Deep Pore Cleanser with Saw Palmetto and Mint. Both of my young adult children used the old version for years and it was perfect for their skin needs. Neither likes the new formula with Active Charcoal Detoxifying and feel its not clean enough and too heavy. We will begin a search for a new product while wishing that Origins would bring back their wonderful original Zero Oil formula.

avis.titre: Original zero oil soooo much better
avis.texte: Their previous Zero Oil face soap was the best. I never found anything else that worked so well for my skin (and I've tried a lot!). I used it for years. This new soap is terrible… I wanted to like it and gave it a chance but I have tons more blackheads and even breakouts. My face doesn't feel clean. Very disappointed and sad that they discontinued the original and I have to go searching other places for a new face soap again…
I love the clean and invigorating scent of this product and it cleanses so well! I use this AM and PM and it's great for removing makeup.

Why change a formula that worked wonders? This new formula is not good, just please, please, please reconsider bringing back the old formula with Saw Palmetto. The only brand that comes close to the old formula (But not as good) Is La Roche–Possay Effeclair Purifying Foaming Gel Cleanser for Oily Skin, yet it doesn't have saw palmetto in it and I think that is the magic ingredient.

avis.titre: Loved the Sample, Now Buying Full Size
avis.texte: I received a sample of this product in a recent order. I really like it- it was refreshing and cleansing feeling. I am getting ready to purchase a full size of the cleanser.

I've gotten at least 3 friends hooked on this product because they once asked me what my night ritual was to remove my makeup. I said I just wash and rinse my face. They asked what about mascara and eye makeup? And I said I just scrub it with the origins black soap and rinse. That's it. They couldn't believe it until they tried it. I have normal to dry skin and have used origins washes for ages. I started when they made a product called mint wash that came in a glass bottle and you could take it back for recycling. Then they moved to plastic then they discontinued it all together and clear improvement is the only thing that comes close to it. The product cleans and leaves your skin ready for moisturizers and toners. It doesn't dry my face or irritate my eyes and I have sensitive eyes! I just hope they don't discontinue this as well.

I absolutely love this product. My face looks so fresh and clean after each and every wash. Then all day long. This is my new absolute favorite product of the Origins line. My old absolute favorite was the eye cream but they changed it and that change is terrible!

I tried this product since it came out because of the discontinuation of zero oil saw palmetto and mint cleanser. It feels slimy and does not lather nor does my skin feel clean afterwards. Zero oil was the one product that I finally found that helped with oil control and reducing pore size, this does not. This product may have use for some, but for me with overly oily skin, this does not cut it. I will regretfully have to go back to biore.

I've been using this cleanser daily for the last year and I absolutely love the way my skin feels. I've always had acne-prone and very sensitive skin, so finding this has done wonders for me. Prior to this, I used Cetaphil cleansers until I started getting more hormonal breakouts. This has helped my skin so much! I love the gel-like texture and it has no problem removing makeup without stripping my face. It does have salicylic acid in it which can be drying, so using a moisturizer afterwards is always a good idea, although this has never made my skin feel dry. I had never used any previous formula other than this one as other reviews have mentioned this product has changed. I love this one the way it is, and it absolutely works for me. This product is gentle enough to use on my sensitive skin as part of my daily/nightly routines (paired with Clear Improvements moisturizer, Retinol, Nightamins and a hydrating moisturizer on rotation).

I bought this not realizing the original saw palmetto and mint formula was swapped for this and was greatly disappointed. I've been using Zero oil face wash for 15 years and was my holy grail face wash. This newer formula doesn't break up oil on my face and I broke out two weeks into using this!! Very sad they've replaced the original, the new one does not even come close.

I have been using the original Zero Oil Cleanser for years. Just started using this one. Had to look at the bottle a few times since it has a dark texture. Well, I couldn't understand why I had serious breakouts until I found this one. Nothing had changed in my skincare except this one. Please give us the option to buy the one with the original formula. Thanks.

Why why WHY did you get rid of the original?! I agree 100% with most of these other reviews.. I've been using the original clear improvements for YEARS. One of the few that I could rely on, it washed clean, felt good, kept my skin clear. Then I accidentally bought this w/out noticing it had changed and hated it from the get go. It's thick, goopy, doesn't come out of my travel bottle easily, and it just feels slimy. It's more like a mask. PLEASE bring back the original!! This really really disappointed me.

I have been using the old version for over 10 years and loved it. I am having breakouts and am stuck with another bottle as I bought two of them without realizing I bought something different. Not sure what I'm going to do now as my skin is really sensitive. Bring the old one back!

I agree with the other reviews… the old formula was much better and I'm holding onto the remaining of what I have left in that bottle. I don't understand why origins has to get rid of amazing products or change ingredients in other products (make a difference plus moisturizer, clear improvement, etc) I guess it's time to start looking for another and more reliable brand which is sad because I have been a loyal customer for over 15 years…

avis.titre: I really like this for congestion
avis.texte: I was skeptical about this product being everyone complains about it on here but I was surprised with how good it is. I love how it suds up. A little goes a long way. I like the subtle scent of wintergreen. I massage it into my skin for about 30 seconds to allow for the volcanic to absorb some of my built up oil and impurities. This is a go to for me now as I have been using it a couple months now.

avis.titre: I don't get why they changed this
avis.texte: I was a long-time user of the old formulation, with saw palmetto and mint. I used it for almost 15 years, tried other face washes in between, but always went back. I don't get why they changed what was a very popular product from what I could tell. If it's to get in on the activated charcoal gimmick, which I'm guessing is cheaper to produce than the formula with saw palmetto and mint, then that's very, very disappointing. There are dermatology journal articles discussing how charcoal doesn't do anything on face skin, and certainly nothing in the period of time that you would have face wash on. This doesn't have mint so you do not get the fresh feeling afterward. This feels like any other facewash that you could get at a drug store, except it cost 2 or 3 times as much. It's just a weirdly colored mild soap. In summary, 1 star, F, do not recommend, please discontinue. I'm switching facewashes, which was the last product from Origins I was still buying. SMH my head.

This new formula is definitely not it. I fell in love with the original formula for the zero oil saw palmetto and noticed that it was now repackaged as this product which is completely different. It's a thicker goupy formula that made my face revert back to an oily mess with frequent breakouts. Charcoal has gotten so trendy that brands are going away from what is tried and true. The original Zero oil was the perfect texture, smell and lather that was the only thing that worked to make my skin blemish free, smooth and glowy. I haven't found anything like it again, it was my holy grail for 5+ years. I wish they would bring it back, myself, my sister and a friend of mine are all in shambles since they got rid of it.

I really liked the original face wash. It made my skin feel so clean. The new one breaks me out and feels oily afterwards. I keep getting pimples on my nose. After using for 3 weeks, I threw it away. Never again.

I started using this product several weeks ago and I really like it. I'm 59 and still have oily skin and tend to have clogged pores and breakouts. It is hard to find something that doesn't dry you out but controls the oil. My skin feels soft and smooth and not flaky from being too dried out. The overall appearance has improved with less breakouts. I use this, the Zero Oil toner and the Clear Improvement moisturizer along with it. I would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: I would NOT buy this product again.
avis.texte: I've used origins for 15+ years and have enjoyed the old version of this because I have very sensitive skin. I don't wear facial makeup only a bit of cocoa butter for lotion. I purchased this and was highly disappointed. I had many many breakouts after a week of using this new formulation. There are many who are allergic to "charcoal" and I am apparently one of them. Please bring back the old product. It wasn't broke, so why try to improve a product that was clearly a great seller.
I did not like this product. I had more breakouts with this product. Given the name, I was expecting a "clear improvement" and it did not deliver

I love this formulation! The previous zero oil did not work well for me but this new one with charcoal keeps my acne controlled. Just remember everyone's different and you have to find what works best for you. This is part of my staple double cleanse!
They changed there formula for this product and the new product is terrible. I was using the old zero oil cleanser for over 10 years. Very aggravating.

avis.titre: feeling similar reviews, not the same formula
avis.texte: The zero oil should not have been messed with. I was so concerned about my break outs and I wasn't sure what was doing it but after reading similar reviews I know for certain it is this changed product.

I wish we still had the option for the original zero oil without charcoal. The new one is not for everyday. My skin feels different. Rough. Which is weird because I have oily skin. Going to have to refigure out my summer regimen. We continue to use but not everyday.

I would give this reformulation zero stars if I could. You replaced the best oily skin face wash I've ever used with a reformulation that doesn't clean as well and irritates the skin. Epic fail! Luckily I bought 30+ bottles of the original Zero Oil to hold me over for awhile until I can find a replacement from another brand. Please get rid of this "Clear Downgrade" reformulation and bring back the old formula.

I am really surprised at the negative reviews. I have always had sensitive skin, prone to breaking out. This cleanser always makes my skin feel so clean without over drying or breaking out. I also use the charcoal moisturizer in the morning and the plantscriptions + nightamins at night :) My skins feels the best with these products!

avis.titre: Bring back the old Zero Oil cleanser!!!
avis.texte: I used to LOVE the whole zero oil line (cleanser, acne wipes, and moisturizer) and now everything but the toner has been discontinued or changed! The original zero oil cleanser felt so clean and refreshing, and I loved how it was very unscented and simple. The new charcoal version does not have the same simple and clean effect. It never should've been changed from the original.

Sometime you shouldn't change things, and this was one of them. I have bought Zero oil line for a long time, the cleanser was the best. Refreshing, didn't dry your skin. Now the new 1 they combined the charcoal cleaners with the zero oil. It doesn't work as well. The scent is different, not refreshing. It's hard to believe there's salicylic acid in there. I luckily have one more of the old zero oil and after I use it, I'll likely find a different brand.

This was my holy grail product, and the only thing that kept my acne under control. Don't know why they changed it- I'm assuming saw palmetto is hard to get these days- but it's just not even close to the same. Having terrible acne break outs again. Very sad I'll have to find another cleanser.
The old one that was just the charcoal powder worked great. This one I'm not so sure.

ive been using zero oil for 20+ years. always loved it felt clean and smooth after use...the new and improved is horrible.. weird smell, skin feels icky afterwards like it wasnt clean...now im stuck with finding a new skin care cleaner soo sad...please bring back the original zero oil!!

avis.titre: I do not like the smell
avis.texte: I want my zero oil back. I do not like the new smell, it is so strong. And they should have changed the package, very misleading!

I loved the Zero Oil cleanser, it worked great. This reformulation is not as effective. I've used 2/3 of the Clear Improvement bottle and have had more acne than I remember having in quite some time. I hope they bring back the Zero Oil cleanser; that one actually worked.
Got this as a sample and I don't like it. Please being back the old zero oil. I want my face back. Thnx.

avis.titre: Did not care for this update
avis.texte: I mistakenly purchased this cleanser thinking it was the original Zero Original. I don't care for the smell. The color is off putting, a dark gray. Not sure I particularly like the texture, it's on the thicker side. It works fine, I suppose. Just not the same experience as the original Zero Oil. Really wish the packaging was done differently so I won't make this mistake again. This is a pass for me and I suspect this product won't be around for long. It's a miss. Thankfully, the original Zero Oil is back in stock. I'll begrudgingly use the rest of this bottle and move on with life.

avis.titre: If it's not broke … don't fix it.
avis.texte: Origins has been a grail for me and I love that it's natural products which I set out looking for. But, reformulating the No Oil Cleanser .. was an unnecessary move. I do not like it as much as the original and I don't think it performs better. So I'm left with, either find new skincare (because I pair it with the NO Oil Toner and Rescue Mask) or find a way to make this work.

avis.titre: so happy i found this cleanser
avis.texte: I have very oily skin and live in a very humid climate so I'm always struggling with my skin. I have been using this cleanser for about a week and I have definitely noticed a difference. This cleanser gets my skin very clean and doesn't dry it out at all. The smell is a very very subtle minty smell that is very nice. I love this cleanser and would definitely recommend.

I am very happy to see origins come out with a acne fighting regimen. This cleanser helps my skin so much when I have my breakouts. I pair this with the clear improvement moisturizer and they work wonders. Make sure to use the moisturizer with this cleanser for better results!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love the way my skin feels and looks afterwards. I still broke out while using it but the breakouts never lasted very long. My skin was dry after usage so make sure to have a good moisturizer after application.

Ok... so I love The way this feels on my skin and I love how soft my skin feels after, BUT I do not know if it works. Idk if it does what it's marketed to do. I didn't see much of a difference in my breakouts. I still broke out, but those pimples wouldn't last long. I would still get new breakouts though.

Just googled what is the best face wash for oily skin and origins never disappoint You really need just pea size of this product to wash whole face and I am using it with Mia Smart brush All I can say it feels so refreshing and clean after and it does not leave that harsh clean feeling on my face after Definitely recommend this product

No complaints here! I've always love the Origins Checks and Balances face wash but decided to give this one a try and am wowed. I've never had a face wash like this and will never go back to anything else! It smells incredible and despite the black color, it really is more of a translucent gray on skin. My skin feels amazing after and has never felt more clean and clear. 11/10 would recommend this product!
